title: STUDIO III: ADVANCED DESIGN COMMUNICATION
description: Development of presentation and Building Information Modeling (BIM) skills through various computer programs including Adobe Illustrator, Adobe PhotoShop, Sketchup, and Revit Architecture. In-class exercises and take-home assignments.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: DSGN 287.
A minimum grade of C- is required in DSGN 287.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Interior Design (458).
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Required laptop/software. Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.

Textbooks
